# National Association for Music Education (NAfME)

> NAfME's community platform connecting music educators through networking, mentorship, and collaborative resources.

NAfME (National Association for Music Education) operates a community-driven platform powered by Higher Logic, headquartered in Herndon, VA. The platform serves music educators through two main products: NAfME Amplify and NAfME Connect, facilitating professional networking, mentorship, and knowledge sharing within the music education community.
